contributions.detail: Form A (page 3) is STRUCK OUT BY THE FILER: 'N/A' is written in the name column and a single long diagonal stroke runs the full height of the sheet, ending in a check mark. Under the repo-wide ruling that is an EMPTY SCHEDULE -- transcribed, zero rows -- not a row and not a zero-valued transaction. The sheet's printed TOTAL cell holds a slashed-zero glyph (= 0, glyph kept verbatim), matching the cover's line-1 THIS REPORT cell, which is also a slashed zero. Zero rows against a printed zero: exact. Scope is PERIOD, because the CUMULATIVE cell reads 2,844.02, not 0. NOTE the cover oddity traced in balance_chain: 2,844.02 appears BOTH as line 1's TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT and as line 4's cumulative BALANCE. THIS PDF IS A BUNDLE OF TWO REPORTS and they are NOT in chronological order -- the January 2023 annual report comes FIRST in the file, the June 2022 pre-primary report second. The top-level recon is report 1, the report whose pages begin the PDF; per-report reconciliation is in recon_by_report.

expenditures.detail: Form B (page 4) is a wholly blank grid with a slashed-zero glyph in its printed TOTAL cell; cover line 3 holds slashed zeros in the LAST and THIS columns. Zero rows against a printed zero: exact. The line-3 CUMULATIVE cell holds no numeral -- the filer drew a single long DOWN-ARROW through the cumulative cells of lines 2 and 3, pointing at line 4's 2,844.02, i.e. a carry-down mark rather than a figure -- so that anchor is recorded as blank, never as 0. Bundle of two reports, stapled out of chronological order; top-level recon is report 1 -- see recon_by_report.

contributions.detail: Seven Form A rows sum to 5,386.00 -- exactly the schedule's hand-written printed TOTAL (5386.00) and exactly the cover's line-1 TOTALS FROM THIS REPORT. THE SUB-$50 TRAP IS LIVE ON THIS FILING AND WAS AVOIDED: the cover reports a separate 40.00 aggregate of contributions of $50.00 or less (line 2, THIS column), which is NOT itemized on Form A; scoring the rows against line1+line2 (5,426.00) would manufacture a false 40.00 shortfall. Scope is PERIOD -- the cumulative cell is 14,037.44 (= 8,651.44 carried forward + 5,386.00, which closes exactly) and no row set here reaches it.

expenditures.detail: 26 Form B rows sum to 5,266.71, exactly the printed schedule TOTAL and exactly cover line 3 in BOTH the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns; the line-3 LAST cell is blank, i.e. this is the first EXPENSE report of the cycle even though contributions carry 8,651.44 forward, so the two expense scopes coincide -- recorded as cumulative with the coincidence stated.

gates.page_subtotal: All four schedules print a TOTAL and every one of them gates. Report 1: p3 TOTAL is a slashed zero over a struck-out ('N/A') sheet, 0 rows -- gates; p4 TOTAL is a slashed zero over a blank sheet, 0 rows -- gates. Report 2: p7 rows 5,386.00 = printed TOTAL 5386.00 = cover line1-THIS -- gates exactly; p6 rows 5,266.71 = printed TOTAL 5266.71 = cover line3-THIS and -CUMULATIVE -- gates exactly. Nothing failed to gate. The cover's own horizontal chains also close on report 2's line 1: 8,651.44 + 5,386.00 = 14,037.44.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p3 and p4: geometry_status 'gaps', 34 rules / 33 bands over the ~45-row handwritten grid; ZERO inked data rows on either (p3 carries only the filer's 'N/A' and the diagonal strike, p4 nothing), 0 rows emitted from each. p7: 34 rules / 33 bands, pitch 1.72% of page height with the grid top at ~13.3%; 8 grid rows carry ink but only SEVEN are transactions -- grid row 4 holds Lucia Duncan's name and date while grid row 5 holds her wrapped address AND her amount, so the pair is ONE row; 7 rows emitted and grid row 11 renders empty. p6: 36 rules / 35 bands, pitch 1.726%, grid top 13.29%; 26 inked rows, 26 emitted, grid row 27 renders empty.
gates.geometry_proof: p6: the 600-dpi crop of row 1's amount box renders '$ 83.27'; row 26's renders '$ 440.00'; the control crop one row-pitch below renders an EMPTY '$' cell. p7: the crop of the first transaction's amount box (grid row 3) renders '$ 2,000'; the last transaction's (grid row 10) renders '$ 786'; the control one pitch below renders an EMPTY '$' cell. Pages 3 and 4 carry no rows and therefore no pointers.
gates.balance_chain: RUN ACROSS BOTH COVERS. Report 2 closes on its own terms once the filer's convention is read off the page: 14,037.44 (cumulative contributions over $50) - 5,266.71 (cumulative expenses) = 8,770.73, exactly the printed line-4 CUMULATIVE balance. It does NOT close if the 40.00 sub-$50 aggregate is added in (that gives 8,810.73), so the filer EXCLUDED his own line-2 aggregate from the balance; both figures are reported as printed and nothing was recomputed. Report 1 asserts 2,844.02 as its line-4 cumulative balance and repeats the SAME figure in line 1's TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT cell -- i.e. a BALANCE written into a CONTRIBUTIONS carry-forward slot; its lines 2 and 3 cumulative cells hold a drawn down-arrow instead of numerals. THE COVER-TO-COVER CHAIN BETWEEN THE TWO REPORTS IN THIS BUNDLE DOES NOT CLOSE AND CANNOT BE CLOSED FROM THIS PDF: report 2's cumulative contributions are 14,037.44 and its balance 8,770.73, while report 1's carry-forward cell reads 2,844.02 -- neither figure. At least one intervening 2022 filing (the post-primary and/or year-end report) is missing from this PDF, so a human reconciling Almquist's 2022 cycle must pull it; this is reported, not resolved.

notes: BUNDLE OF TWO REPORTS, STAPLED OUT OF CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER (n_reports_in_pdf = 2, AGREEING with the chunk file's n_reports = 2): pages 1-4 are the JANUARY 2023 annual officeholder report (handwritten cover, both schedules empty) and pages 5-7 are the JUNE 2022 pre-primary report (typed cover and typed schedules). Two structural facts a reader must not trip over: PAGE 2 IS A GHOST PAGE -- a wholly blank sheet with no form printing at all, sitting between report 1's cover and its Form A, so report 1's schedules are on pages 3 and 4 rather than the 2 and 3 its own printed footers claim; and REPORT 2'S SCHEDULES ARE IN REVERSE ORDER -- page 6 is Form B and page 7 is Form A. Both are Generation-2 county-branded forms ('WASHINGTON COUNTY CANDIDATE FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT', Washington County Code 1-7-1). CHUNK FILE AGREES WITH THE DOCUMENT: candidate 'GILBERT MICHAEL ALMQUIST' matches both covers' Full Name of Candidate, and office 'Commission Seat A' matches the Office line 'Washington County Commissioner' with Representative District 'SEAT A' on both. County office, in scope. Clerk named Susan Lewis on both. THE FILER'S OWN STRIKE-OUT ON REPORT 1'S FORM A ('N/A' plus a full-height diagonal ending in a check) is an EMPTY SCHEDULE, not a transaction -- and the printed TOTAL cell's slashed zero confirms it. Report 2 carries the filing's ONE in-kind entry (Jill Almquist, 786, In Kind? answered 'yes'); every other row answers 'no', which is a real 'no' rather than a blank on this typed schedule. Two typed date cells are unusable as written -- Form A's '4/2022' (month and year, no day) is BLANK with needs_review=1, verbatim kept -- and two typed strings are kept verbatim with [sic] ('MV' for the Las Vegas donor's state, 'Rack Cark', 'Campaign Add'). Every amount is legible; no row is blank for illegibility and no side is a floor. Candidate street address, ZIP and home phone printed in the clear on both covers, and every donor street address, PO box and ZIP on Form A, were discarded at read time per PRIVACY.
